reviews.author: Ryan Buller
reviews.text: The gentlemen up at Morgan's Auto are extremely knowledgeable and work very fast. My bills have always been very reasonable. I would definitely recommend Morgan's auto to anyone in need of auto repairs.

reviews.author: Danil Chostko
reviews.text: The only transmission repair shop you need to visit. Skip general mechanics for transmission work. Honest mechanic.

reviews.author: Richard Hammill
reviews.text: They were honest with their estimate and what they could accomplish at a price within reason. I decided not to pursue a repair as some of the parts are no longer available worldwide.

reviews.author: michael holm
reviews.text: Exceptional service at a fair and reasonable price. I had a tough repair on my truck I did not want to do myself. Ronnie stayed in communication with me every step of the way, I loved that.

reviews.author: LESLIE DIGIACOMO
reviews.text: After trying a few different mechanics and getting over charged for sub par work, we found Morgan's Auto Repair. Now we will only take our vehicles to Morgan's! Fair prices for fast, honest quality work!
